_comment: One rule set for every command. A rule needs an AWS-documented deviation or a deterministic target state. Kinds: deviation, dependency, literal, exemption, quota, mechanism; see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. `source.guide` quotes a difference on the ESC User Guide, checked against the live guide on every run for ESC targets; `source.doc` quotes a sentence on another AWS page, checked by the ignored network test. Availability itself never comes from rules.

remediation.change: Replace the global table with a single-Region table: AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable becomes AWS::DynamoDB::Table (CDK TableV2 becomes Table, awscc_dynamodb_global_table becomes aws_dynamodb_table) and aws_dynamodb_table_replica resources are removed. Carry the keys, indexes, stream, TTL and encryption settings over, and set the billing mode explicitly.
remediation.consequence: The new resource type replaces the table, so an existing table's data must be migrated. CDK Table defaults to provisioned capacity, TableV2 to on-demand.

remediation.consequence: No copies of the secret exist in other Regions.

Lambda begins blocking creation of new functions

remediation.change: Lambda no longer creates functions with this deprecated runtime, so the function cannot be created in the target. Move it to a supported runtime of the same language from the Lambda runtimes table.
remediation.consequence: Code and dependencies may need changes between language versions.

doc.quote: For new AWS Regions, Lambda doesn't support runtimes that are set to be deprecated within the next 6 months.
To use an ACM certificate with a CloudFront distribution, make sure you request (or import) the certificate in the US East (N. Virginia) Region (us-east-1).
To use an ACM certificate with a CloudFront distribution, make sure you request (or import) the certificate in the US East (N. Virginia) Region (us-east-1).

remediation.change: CloudFront takes ACM certificates from us-east-1 only, so the certificate does not move with the input. Request or import it in us-east-1 and pass its ARN to the distribution.
remediation.consequence: The input keeps a dependency on us-east-1.

doc.quote: You can use this context key to limit access to AWS services within a given set of Regions.

remediation.change: The policy limits the Regions requests may go to with the aws:RequestedRegion condition key. Make sure the condition allows the target Region, for example by taking the Region list from a parameter.
remediation.consequence: A condition that leaves the target out denies, or fails to allow, the requests there.

doc.quote: each bucket name must be unique across all AWS accounts in all the AWS Regions within a partition

remediation.action: let the bucket name be generated
remediation.change: Bucket names are unique across all accounts and Regions of a partition, so this fixed name is taken while the source bucket exists. Leave the name out so it is generated, or derive it from the account and Region.
remediation.consequence: Code and policies that use the name must take it from the input instead.
